summary.text: Kent Weston is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate, representing District 15 (home city listed as Sarles), serving since 2023 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Weston lists an occupation of Farmer; Owner, Agronomy Business.
It lists education as BA, Ag Engineering, NDSU.
It also lists Rock Lake School Board, Border Central School Board and Eagles.
Family is listed as: Married (Suzanne); 3 children.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Weston's standing committee assignments as Human Services (vice chair) and Agriculture and Veterans Affairs.
